unit_conversion: Original column hg/ha. 1 hg = 100 g = 0.1 kg = 0.0001 t, so t/ha = hg/ha / 10,000. The model is trained on t/ha directly; predictions are NOT converted again.
selection_method: Lowest mean 5-fold cross-validated RMSE on the training split (test data not used)

training.note: The saved model is fitted on the random training split only, so the reported hold-out metrics describe exactly the model that is served.

dataset.name: Crop Yield Prediction Dataset (file: yield_df.csv)
dataset.source: Kaggle dataset by owner 'patelris'. Dataset descriptions on mirror sites credit FAO and the World Bank as original sources; the per-variable mapping is not documented, so it is not claimed here
